title: Automated Plant MoClo Level 1 Golden Gate assembly with colony PCR verification
goal: Test whether OT-2 BOTany1-3 workflows (primer dilution, PCR setup, Golden Gate assembly) correctly assemble seven Plant MoClo Level 1 vectors, verified by colony PCR.

title: Automated E. coli transformation (BOTany4-Shock&Go) with blue/white screening
goal: Validate parallel heat-shock transformation of competent E. coli with Plant MoClo assemblies on the OT-2 by colony counts and fraction of blue (empty-vector) colonies.

title: MagBead plasmid extraction and downstream use in Golden Gate assembly, E. coli transformation and colony PCR
goal: Show that plasmids extracted semi-automatically with Zyppy-96 MagBead kit on OT-2 are suitable for Golden Gate assembly and E. coli transformation, with colony PCR genotyping of resulting colonies.
